features.proposal: extend the artMap branch to extract parenthesised content into element text for breath-mark (and caesura): !breath(tick)! -> <breath-mark>tick</breath-mark>. Consistent with the existing ornMap/tecMap re.search(r'\((.*?)\)') convention

2 decorated notes -> 2 <notations>/<fermata type="upright"> (both spellings), empty content = MusicXML default 'normal' shape; others clean

emits <fermata type="upright" shape="long"> and shape="short" -- 'shape' is NOT a MusicXML fermata attribute (only type/id/print-style); the shape belongs in element TEXT from the fermata-shape enum (normal/angled/square/...). MuseScore ignores the unknown attribute, so both render as plain fermatas: shape silently lost
